Publish.LongDescription:
# ExtraUITheme
ExtraUITheme lets you customize the look of the Cities: Skylines II UI directly from an in-game panel, by editing the game's CSS custom properties (colors, spacing, radii, and more) instead of hand-editing files.
Requires [ExtraLib](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/75724/Windows) as a dependency.
# Features * Simple mode — curated, grouped variables (panel colors, text colors, accents, borders, ...) for quick theming without digging through the full list. * Advanced mode — every :root-overridable variable exposed as a flat, searchable list. * Built-in presets — ready-made themes you can apply instantly. * Custom themes — fork, rename, and save your own themes. * Import / Export — share themes as plain JSON.
